_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit it. config.json is gitignored. Every active script refuses to run against a live target unless 'authorised' is true AND a host/port are set here. Point this ONLY at a gateway/ESP32 you own on an isolated lab network.

target._note: The laptop gateway listens on 0.0.0.0:9000 (PQC_VPN/laptop_server/config.py PORT=9000).

esp32._note: Used only by Test 2 inspection commands; no flash is read in the preparation phase.

lab._note: device_id must match an entry in PQC_VPN/laptop_server/authorized_devices.json for auth-path tests.

limits._note: Hard ceilings for Test 5. Scripts clamp to these; they are intentionally small to probe the documented caps (8 global handshakes / 2 per IP / 5 per 10s), not to flood.
